project_type: React 19 SPA, TanStack Router (file-based), Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: Vite 8 via @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config. Build command: npm run build. Dev: npm run dev. No custom rollup config.
test_framework: None (no test runner configured). Verification = npm run build passing with zero TS errors.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from d:\BHURAKSHAK GIT. Zero TypeScript errors = passing. Also run `npm run lint` if time permits.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by @tanstack/router-plugin on build. Do NOT hand-edit it.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell. Workspace root is d:\BHURAKSHAK GIT. All commands must be run from that directory. The app is NOT running during build steps.
contribution_requirements: Connected to Lovable — never force-push, rebase, amend, or squash already-pushed commits. Keep the branch in a working (buildable) state after every commit.
key_patterns: Tailwind v4 utility classes. Breakpoints: sm=640px md=768px lg=1024px. Role colours: operator=#ef4444, planner=#3b82f6, regulator=#8b5cf6. DashboardShell passes role/nav/activeTab/onTabChange/accent down the tree. Sidebar is already lg:flex (hidden below 1024px). FloatingAIChat already has bottom:calc(4rem+0.5rem) so it clears a 64px bottom nav.
directory_structure: src/components/layout/ — shell, header, sidebar, floating AI chat. src/components/common/ — reusable KpiCard, DataTable, FilterBar, Panels, AlertCard. src/components/operator/ — 9 tab files. src/components/planner/ — 8 tab files. src/components/regulator/ — 6 tab files. src/components/gis/ — MapCore, KmlLayer, NodeDetailPanel, MapLayers, SensorNetworkGraph. src/routes/ — __root.tsx, index.tsx, operator.tsx, planner.tsx, regulator.tsx, system.tsx. src/hooks/ — useLiveMonitoring.ts, useMediaQuery.ts, useHighRiskZone.ts, use-mobile.tsx. src/data/ — mock data, index.ts.
